title: Installation.
officialText: A draft hood supplied with or forming a part of a listed vented appliance shall be installed without alteration, exactly as furnished and specified by the appliance manufacturer. Draft hoods shall be equipped with a thermal safety (spill) switch installed in accordance with its listing and the manufacturer’s instructions.
